verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment that AgentMail's enterprise options include Bring Your Own Cloud. That would let a customer keep data in its own cloud environment, but it is secondhand, enterprise-only, and no first-party docs describe region selection or residency controls. Pods isolation and SOC 2 are adjacent features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of region/residency selection, availability outside enterprise plans, details of which regions or clouds BYOC supports, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: They appreciated that the enterprise options include Bring Your Own Cloud, which 'makes things much easier for us.'
